name: Barbell T-Bar Row
steps: Straddle a barbell anchored at its far end, hinge forward at your hips with soft knees, and grip the shaft just below the weighted sleeve.
Brace your abdomen and hold your torso steady with your neck in line with your back.
Drive both elbows smoothly behind you to pull the bar toward your lower chest while squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower the bar slowly back to full arm extension while holding your torso angle fixed.
tips: Keep your hips and back angle steady rather than bouncing upright to lift heavier loads.
Keep the elbows close and lower until the arms lengthen without rounding your back.
